title: PortSpenderNote Country Configuration
description: Single declarative configuration file defining locale metadata, LLM extraction rules, and local billing-statement filter phrases for one country.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor validation and autocomplete.

code.description: Two-letter uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Must match the filename stem (e.g. ID.json -> "ID").

name.description: Human-readable country display name shown in Settings.

currency.description: Three-letter uppercase ISO 4217 default currency code (e.g. "IDR", "JPY", "EUR").

defaultTimezone.description: Default IANA timezone identifier. Must appear in the timezones array.

timezones.description: Selectable IANA timezone identifiers for this country.

llmPromptRules.description: Country-specific rules appended to the LLM extraction system prompt after universal date, time, and timezone rules (e.g. local currency separator conventions, local timezone abbreviations, common local wallets).

billingStatementFilter.description: Local-language phrases layered on top of universal English phrases to detect and skip monthly credit card or bank billing statements before LLM extraction.

subjectPhrases.description: Lowercase subject substrings that unmistakably identify a billing statement email.

bodyPrimaryCues.description: Lowercase body substrings identifying a statement total or summary; matched only when paired with a bodySecondaryCue.

bodySecondaryCues.description: Lowercase body substrings identifying a minimum payment or payment due date; matched only when paired with a bodyPrimaryCue.
